newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-CZECHS DIG DEEP FOR DAVIS CUP NOMINATIONS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CZECHS DIG DEEP FOR DAVIS CUP NOMINATIONS.

text.p: Czech Davis Cup captain Vladislav Savrda was forced to dig deep on Tuesday to come up with a team for next month's quarter-final in Australia.
Petr Korda, Daniel Vacek, Bohdan Ulihrach and Slava Dosedel all declined to play in Adelaide, leaving Savrda little choice for his official nominations.

Savrda, who used Korda and Vacek to propel the Czechs into the semifinals of last year's tournament, named world number 57 Jiri Novak and 43rd-ranked Martin Damm for the singles of the April 4-6 tie, while Pavel Vizner and David Rikl will team up for the doubles.
Korda shocked Czech tennis fans earlier this year when he came off court after a first-round win against India and said he was retiring from Davis Cup competition.
Korda, who was once ranked fifth in the world, has been the anchor of the Czech team since his debut in 1988, compiling a 30-12 overall record, including three wins against India.
Czech number two Daniel Vacek bowed out of action late last year to concentrate more on his performance on the ATP tour.

Ulihrach, who recently defeated world number one Pete Sampras on his way to the final of the Champions' Cup at Indian Wells two weeks ago, has been locked in a dispute with Savrda over playing guarantees.
